Definition: Ammiel, the name of three or four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ammiel = "my kinsman is God"; 1) the spy from the tribe of Dan who perished in the plague for his evil report; 2) father of Machir of Lo-debar; 3) father of Bathsheba; also 'Eliam'; 4) the 6th son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper of the temple
